'''Zronta grazers''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] that were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Pii III]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]] had a mild temperament.<ref name="Greel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zronta grazers were mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," an article featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[May]] of [[1995]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Greel" />
